ev.q: one sample was collected from each of 88 flights
Twenty-seven SARS-CoV-2 genomes were detected in 25 wastewater samples
the percentage that were positive was similar among the three flight origin countries sampled
evaluated the feasibility of SARS-CoV-2 variant detection in aircraft wastewater

methods_quotes.q: Multiple lineages within samples were identified using Freyja
Sequences meeting quality control criteria (e.g., >70% genome coverage)
Samples with cycle thresholds <40 underwent whole genome sequencing
